related.title: PyMatching Sparse Blossom：機率如何成為邊權重
related.titleEn: PyMatching Sparse Blossom: probabilities become edge weights
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：長期服務率必須大於資料產生率且緩衝可承受突發，不能只拿單次解碼速度驗收。 另一位學徒須能從輸入與算式重算，而非僅讀結論。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Sustained service must exceed production and buffers must absorb bursts; one decode benchmark is insufficient. A second learner must be able to reconstruct the result from inputs and equations.
related.difference: 從錯誤機率推導對數勝算權重，區分短路徑與高機率路徑。
related.differenceEn: Derive log-odds weights from error probabilities, distinguishing shortest paths from most likely paths.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 以下情境參數為合成教學輸入，並非案例設備實測或廠商規格；光速、波茲曼常數等標準物理常數另依名稱與單位標明。d=5理想旋轉碼有24個校驗，每1μs輸出一次，每校驗1bit。 R=(5²−1)/1μs，換成Mbit/s。 代入 (5**2-1)/1e-6/1e6，得到 24 Mbit/s。未壓縮校驗資料率R=Ncheck/Tcycle；尚不含封包、時間標籤、軟資訊與錯誤更正編碼。 將式子拆成至少兩個中間欄，逐欄保留單位。

以下情境參數為合成教學輸入，並非案例設備實測或廠商規格；光速、波茲曼常數等標準物理常數另依名稱與單位標明。單邊錯誤率p=0.01，對數採自然底；只分析一個局部圖邊。 w=ln(0.99/0.01)。 代入 log((1-0.01)/0.01)，得到 4.59512 log-odds units。獨立圖邊錯誤模型的權重w=ln[(1−p)/p]；相關超邊與退化情況可能需更完整解碼。 將式子拆成至少兩個中間欄，逐欄保留單位。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Scenario parameters below are synthetic teaching inputs, not measurements or specifications of the named device; standard physical constants such as the speed of light and Boltzmann constant are identified separately by name and unit. An ideald=5 rotated code has24 checks, each producing1bit every1μs. R=(5²−1)/1μs inMbit/s. Substituting (5**2-1)/1e-6/1e6 gives 24 Mbit/s. Raw check rateR=Ncheck/Tcycle excludes packets, timestamps, soft information and channel coding. Split the expression into at least two intermediate columns and retain their units.

Scenario parameters below are synthetic teaching inputs, not measurements or specifications of the named device; standard physical constants such as the speed of light and Boltzmann constant are identified separately by name and unit. One edge hasp=0.01 with natural logarithms; analyze a local edge only. w=ln(0.99/0.01). Substituting log((1-0.01)/0.01) gives 4.59512 log-odds units. Independent graph-edge errors usew=ln[(1−p)/p]; correlated hyperedges and degeneracy can require richer decoding. Split the expression into at least two intermediate columns and retain their units.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
